Travelling by charter ship is very convenient for players who can afford it, especially since the release of Sailing. Some of the quickest ways to get to the ships are:
*Use the [[Sailors' amulet]] teleport to [[Deepfin Point]], ~4 tiles away from the charter crew which is by far the fastest method.
*Use the [[Sailors' amulet]] teleport to [[Red Rock]] following partial completion of quest [[The Red Reef]].
*[[Construction cape]] or [[Aldarin teleport|Aldarin teleport tablets]] to teleport to the [[Aldarin]] [[house portal]], which puts you close to the dock. If your house is in Aldarin, you could also use the [[Teleport to House]] spell or tablet.
*[[Sailors' amulet]] teleport to [[The Pandemonium]].
*Use the [[Lunar spell]] [[Catherby Teleport]] and run south.
*Use a [[Pest control teleport|Pest Control teleport]] scroll and take the ship to [[Port Sarim]], then go south east.
*Use the [[Fishing Trawler]] [[minigame teleport]] or the Lunar spell [[Khazard Teleport]] to Port Khazard.
*Use [[Rada's blessing]] to teleport to the [[Kourend Woodland]], then run to the [[Land's End]] docks.
*Use an [[Ectophial]] to go to the [[Ectofuntus]] and enter [[Port Phasmatys]]. The docks are somewhat near the Port Phasmatys entrance.
*Use a [[Camelot Teleport]] and run south-east to Catherby and its docks.
*Use a [[Civitas illa Fortis Teleport|Civitas Teleport]] and run east.
*Use an [[Ardougne Teleport]] to go to the [[Ardougne]] marketplace, run south to [[Captain Barnaby]] and take his boat to [[Brimhaven]]. The boat trip arrives at the Brimhaven docks.
*If your house is in [[Brimhaven]], you might consider using [[Teleport to House]] spell or tablet and running north.
*A [[spirit tree]] in [[Port Sarim]]. Planting the spirit tree requires 83 [[Farming]]; using the spirit tree network requires completion of the [[Tree Gnome Village]] quest.
*Alternatively, you can use [[Explorer's ring|Explorer's Ring]] teleport to cabbage patch next to [[Port Sarim]], or the Rat Pits [[Minigame Teleport]].
* If your house is in [[Rimmington]], you can teleport to your house and run east to [[Port Sarim]]. Alternatively you can run west and talk to [[Cabin Boy Colin]] to travel to [[Corsair Cove]], where you can change and travel to your destination (requires completion of [[The Corsair Curse]]).
